title: Israel Finally Admits to Killing Hind Rajab. 933 Days Later
author: Prem Thakker
content:
It took Israel more than two and a half years to
[admit](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/19/middleeast/israel-military-idf-hind-
rajab-firing-intl) to what the world already knew: Israeli soldiers fired at
the vehicle of Hind Rajab and her family. The admission comes after years of
denials that were accepted with full embrace by U.S. State Department
officials. There are very few journalists here in the U.S. who tried to hold
those officials to [account](https://zeteo.com/p/200-days-justice-for-hind) in
the way **Zeteo 's **political correspondent **[Prem
Thakker](https://zeteo.com/p/hind-rajab-oja-award-israel-
genocide?utm_campaign=23956408708&utm_source=google_ads&utm_medium=cpc&utm_content=-&utm_term=&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23946692121&gbraid=0AAAAA-F9BaxFxzKsyJ2iLRW3fUPmIhCD_&gclid=CjwKCAjwy5rUBhB5EiwAIoAtCn1QXBW72k3rvYwZC-
RX9lEyC2dTs4bAr_Fp0wflogXPkLq4QUJSohoCS50QAvD_BwE) **did**.**

**" All the U.S. did was feign concern, defer to Israel to investigate itself
for murder, and resist the facts over and over,"** says Thakker in his latest
video on the case of Hind Rajab.

The 5-year-old's harrowing story drew international outrage after her phone
call recording with the Palestinian Red Crescent captured her final hours,
sheltering from Israeli gunfire in a car with the bodies of her dead relatives
around her. The Israeli army also [killed the medics
](https://apnews.com/article/gaza-israel-palestinians-war-ambulance-girl-
family-06f15b155f1de426e00f6a655554b2a2)who were sent to save her.

It took Israel 933 days to admit to a killing that went viral beyond
headlines, one that inspired the [Oscar-nominated](https://zeteo.com/p/voice-
of-hind-rajab-israel-oscar-campaign) film '[The Voice of Hind
Rajab](https://zeteo.com/p/today-1pm-et-director-of-oscar-nominated),' and in
which the victim's testimony was caught on tape. Watch Prem reflect on what
the admission means for Hind, and the more than 73,000 Palestinians killed
since the start of the genocide, including 20,000 children.
